The '''Walin'or cell''' was a cell of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]<ref name="AIR" /> that originated in<ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the Walin'or cell|system=[[Walin'or system/Legends|Walin'or system]]|legends=1}}</ref> the [[Walin'or system/Legends|Walin'or system]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Shiwal sector/Legends|Shiwal sector]].<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> Approximately five [[Standard month/Legends|standard months]] before<ref name="AIR" /> some point in [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'' represents a collection of [[in-universe]] reports from "one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]," which corresponds to [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> the Alliance agent [[Patel Odfath]] had in his possession several high-security [[Datafile/Legends|datafiles]] that contained details regarding the operations of Alliance cells in the Shiwal [[Sector/Legends|sector]] as well as the [[Cademimu sector/Legends|Cademimu sector]]<ref name="AIR" /> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EGTW" /> At that time, Odfath was captured by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Lu'daal-ud]], whom the Alliance believed had kept the datafiles. The possibility that Lu'daal-ud would then sell the files to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was estimated by the Alliance to endanger the lives of almost a thousand operatives active in the region ranging from the Walin'or cell to the [[Tierfon Rebel Outpost]]<ref name="AIR" /> in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="SoR">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Walin'or cell was mentioned in ''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'', a [[1995]] sourcebook for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="AIR" />
